scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w extension
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/worker && uv run python -m worker serve
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.start: npm run build -w web && concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w web" "npm run dev:worker"
